Export the filtered peak table and matching spectra

mc_export.Rd

Collect the current filtered peak table and optionally retain matching MGF spectra. Write either or both outputs when filenames are supplied.

mc_export(x, csv = NULL, mgf = NULL, mgf_file = NULL, id_field = "acquisitionNum",
    match_col = NULL, format = c("input", "standard", "internal"))

Arguments

x

A metabocensor_result returned by mc_prepare() or a filtering function.

csv

Optional output CSV filename. NULL returns the table without writing a CSV.

mgf

Optional local MGF filename or Spectra object. Spectra are matched to retained feature IDs.

mgf_file

Optional output MGF filename. Requires mgf.

id_field

Spectrum metadata field containing feature IDs. Default: "acquisitionNum".

match_col

Optional ID column in the exported table. NULL uses the ID column selected at import, regardless of output layout.

format

Output layout: "input" (default) restores original column names and order, metadata columns, and XCMS retention times in seconds; "standard" returns Feature ID, mz, rt in minutes, and sample intensities; "internal" returns the current table including .FID.

Details

All previously applied filters are already reflected in the current table. Export does not rerun filtering or restore removed rows. Matching retains all spectra associated with each retained feature, including duplicate spectra. No additional MS-level restriction is applied. Annotation and metric tables remain in the result object; they are not automatically written into the peak-table CSV.

Value

A list with table, the final data frame, and spectra, the matching Spectra object or NULL. Requested CSV/MGF files are also written.

See also

mc_final_table, mc_filter_mgf, mc_write_table

Examples

if (FALSE) {
# The peak table and labels are bundled; only MGF requires internet.
peak_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "orbi_iimn_gnps_quant.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported <- mc_prepare(
  peak_file, type = "mzmine",
  sample_keywords = c(".mzML", "Peak area")
)
metadata_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "metadata.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported$labels <- mc_labels_from_metadata(
  metadata_file, sample_names = imported$sample_cols,
  sample_col = "Sample name", label_col = "Label"
)
after_blank <- mc_filter_blank(
  imported, groups = "Blank", mode = "mean_cutoff", cutoff = 0.10
)
mgf_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plyush1993/",
  "MetaboCensoR_Examples/main/orbi/orbi_iimn_gnps.mgf"
)
mgf_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".mgf")
download.file(mgf_url, mgf_file, mode = "wb")
spectra <- mc_read_mgf(mgf_file)
ms_options <- mc_ms_parameters(
  iso_rt2 = 0.01, iso_cor2 = 0.80,
  iso_tol_type2 = "da", iso_mz_tol2 = 0.005,
  add_rt2 = 0.005, add_cor2 = 0.80,
  add_tol_type2 = "da", add_mz_tol2 = 0.005,
  add_pol2 = "positive",
  isf_rt2 = 0.01, isf_cor2 = 0.95,
  isf_ms2_check2 = TRUE, isf_mgf_id_field = "acquisitionNum",
  isf_ms2_mz_tol2 = 0.01, isf_ms2_rel2 = 1
)
after_ms <- mc_filter_ms(
  after_blank, filters = c("isotopes", "adducts", "isf"),
  parameters = ms_options, spectra = spectra
)
output <- mc_export(
  after_ms,
  csv = file.path(tempdir(), "orbi_filtered.csv"),
  mgf = spectra,
  mgf_file = file.path(tempdir(), "orbi_filtered.mgf")
)
head(output$table)
# Save annotation tables separately when needed:
write.csv(after_ms$annot_tbls$add_table,
          file.path(tempdir(), "orbi_adduct_annotations.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
}
